← Back to Motion

Made for movement.

Kaizen Motion is an open-source instrument by Kaizen DSP / Kaizen Strategic AI Inc. Browser edition: an early playable demo, with CHIMERA, five synth tones and a physical grain shaker. Sound and motion processing run locally. No account, analytics or motion upload.

Source code · MIT license

CHIMERA vocal engine and anatomical 3D renderer by Jameson Hodge. MIT, pinned at dd68078730126c50cd119b18b3889e414c4f4528. License.

Three.js 0.186.1, MIT. Rust dependency licenses are retained in the source and alongside this build. License.

Recorded shaker sources by el_boss, Sadiquecat and Joseph SARDIN, CC0. Source URLs and provenance. The browser uses 32 longer recorded strokes, retaining their natural rattle envelopes. Exact stroke provenance and hashes.

Browser sound, sensor rates and permissions vary by device. There is no native Mac link, AUv3 host support or background performance mode in this web demo.
